sections.overall: Continental Classic season is here! Six of the week's nine men's singles matches were league matches, and the pick of the bunch was the Dynamite main event: Bandido vs Adam Page (8.34). A great match, but with both men already so highly rated, the gains were small. The biggest points-gainers of the week instead came on Collision, where Ilja Dragunov vs El Clon, Dragunov (7.88)'s first National Title defence, gave both men a healthy boost.
sections.mens: Elsewhere in the Continental Classic, Jay White vs Ricochet (7.32) was a solid Collision main event, with gains for both, and Nick Wayne vs Mike Bailey (7.33) on Dynamite was a decent showing that boosted Wayne. Not every league match delivered, though: Jon Moxley vs Orange Cassidy (7.09) fell below expectations, costing both men over two points and dropping Mox from #10 to #12, while Brody King vs Daniel Garcia (6.11) was a loss for both. Tommaso Ciampa also slips to #7 after his Collision opener against Kevin Knight. Who will emerge from the league stages on top?
sections.womens: Queen Aminata retained her TBS Title in the 4 Way against AZM, Maya World and Mina Shirakawa on Dynamite, with small gains for all four women. Aminata moves up to #6 and AZM enters the rankings. Marina Shafir (up to #7) and Thekla (up to #8) also rise without wrestling a singles match, as Megan Bayne and Lena Kross slip after their tag loss on Collision.
sections.menstag: No Men's Tag matches this week. The Infantry were the only established team featured, as part of the mixed 8 Person Tag on Collision. The Young Bucks stay top, and with the Continental Classic taking centre stage, the tag division may have to wait a little longer for its spotlight.
sections.womenstag: Divine Dominion vs Van & Vertvixen (4.72) on Collision was below average and cost the former champs a few points, though they still hold onto #1 ahead of The Brawling Birds. Van & Vertvixen need a second match to enter the rankings.
sections.trios: No straight Trios this week. The Death Riders trio of Castagnoli, Kidd & Yuta faced Infantry & Taylor within the mixed 8 Person Tag on Collision, with little change for either team. New Level & Strickland remain firmly at #1.
